name: shotbox
description: Shotbox is a privacy-first screenshot action engine. It reads the text in your screenshots on-device, extracts useful details like links, prices, addresses, and OTPs, and organizes everything into smart buckets. This plugin lets you search your processed screenshots, browse your buckets, get item details with extracted entities, and view your usage stats — all without your images ever leaving your device.
